g.title: LyonRank4Convo2 begins.
g.text: LyonRank4Convo2 begins.

g.title: j3611551588
g.text: ¿Cómo es posible que tú y Marie puedan conciliar el ser sacerdote y monja, pero también… cometer actos de violencia?

g.title: j76612824
g.text: ¿Puedo hacerte una pregunta un poco extraña, Lyon?

g.title: j2429168889
g.text: [Fin.]

g.title: j134232138
g.text: Oigo a Marie gritar "¡païens!" y lanzarse a la pelea, y... aun así, me cuesta creer que sea el tipo de persona que condena a alguien por tener creencias diferentes. Me imagino que tú tampoco eres muy diferente. Está claro que te tiene en muy alta estima.

g.title: j3366660597
g.text: ¿Cómo se sentiría tu iglesia con lo que tú y Marie están haciendo aquí? ¿Con respecto a lo que se les pide que hagan en su nombre?

g.title: j1117948502
g.text: Los miro a ti y a Marie en el campo de batalla, y luego hablo con ella en privado, y los veo leyendo libros tranquilamente... y supongo que me está costando alinear a esos individuos en mi mente.

g.title: j679635720
g.text: Si te parece que describir nuestra situación actual es simplemente "extraña", me impresiona tu fortaleza o me consterna tu falta de vocabulario. Sin embargo, sospecho que es lo primero.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2773893676
g.text: Tienes toda la razón. Marie no es de las que condenan a alguien por albergar en su corazón a un antiguo dios de los árboles; en cambio, buscaría descubrir qué creencias compartía con ellos.

g.title: j3683999620
g.text: En su época se libraron muchas guerras santas en nombre de Sol o Lua. Sangrientas "cruzadas" para expulsar a los paganos, "tomar tierra santa" o cualquier razonamiento artificioso que prevaleciera en la época.

g.title: j350982998
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2282161637
g.text: ¿Es acaso que el árbol no se nutre de la luz de Sol? ¿No hay un punto en común donde pueda compartir el pan con ellos? Es más propensa a sentarse y escuchar sus historias que a intentar perjudicarlos por su fe.

g.title: j3946875054
g.text: La Ortodoxia Luminaria no tiene ejército ni libra guerras. No impiden que quienes pertenecen a su orden actúen ni protejan a otros.

g.title: j3946634030
g.text: Es decir, sí, adelante. No puedes hacerme sentir más extraño preguntándome lo que te intriga.

g.title: j2545650760
g.text: Cuando ella se enfrenta a su enemigo en el campo de batalla, creo que es una de dos cosas: o se está divirtiendo un poco, actuando como una antigua defensora, imaginándose a sí misma con una brillante armadura de un caballero del Sol -

g.title: j1343091325
g.text: When Marie engages with her foes upon the battlefield, I believe it is one of two things: either, she is having a bit of fun, play-acting as an ancient crusader, imagining herself in the shining armor of a Knight of Sol -

g.title: j3475282207
g.text: O, lo más probable, está recordando a Ástafor 8:23: "Solas son las almas que buscan entrar en mi casa por la fuerza, porque son los expulsados de la luz de Sol".

g.title: j3409153392
g.text: En sus ojos, la violencia que comete es justa en el nombre de un bien mayor, como lo harías tú, como lo harían aquellos junto a quienes luchan, supongo.

g.title: j2221641561
g.text: Y por eso, aquellos contra quienes ella lucha, independientemente de su religión, son expulsados ​​por el Sol. Incluso si llevan las vestiduras sagradas de su propia orden, a los ojos de ella, son paganos.

g.title: j4168579113
g.text: He notado que te has alejado de esto. ¿Cómo te sientes con todo esto de las batallas?

g.title: j1716069413
g.text: Eso tiene sentido. Gracias.

g.title: j4262846589
g.text: Estoy siendo intencionadamente elusivo, Viajero.

g.title: j1369771221
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2918064125
g.text: Y estoy siendo muy persistente, sacerdote.

g.title: j1962264807
g.text: Está bien. Hoy tomaré lo que pueda conseguir.

g.title: j1230560288
g.text: Por si sirve de algo, Marie... me ha dicho que tienes buenas intenciones. Y le creo a ella, incluso cuando yo no lo puedo creer.

g.title: j2573534659
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j615979826
g.text: Al final, solo puedo pedirte paciencia. Lua sabe que casi siempre me falta.

g.title: j3371672424
g.text: Muy bien. Si no te dejas disuadir, ¿y tienes tanta curiosidad? No me preocupa tanto la muerte que causo como... tal vez podrías esperar.

g.title: j944546954
g.text: -F. Lyon Allard

g.title: j520204221
g.text: Or that one might feel is "proper" for a man of the cloth and a scholar such as I.

g.title: j2169526290
g.text: I've known more war than peace in my life, Lyon. If I let it trouble me, I don't think I would still be here. But that isn't to say it doesn't still come with a real burden - a real cost.

g.title: j3056551528
g.text: I'm sure the others have told you who I am. What I am. Where I've come from. The death that follows me - the death I've come from. The death that defines me. Do you think anything you feel will surprise me?

g.title: j3467249208
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j158781669
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j2911912479
g.text: Yes, it does.

g.title: j1894648924
g.text: Yes, I do.

g.title: j1484276980
g.text: I'm sorry. I feel I've upset you. That wasn't my intention.

g.title: j3688443965
g.text: Do you... care to elaborate?

g.title: j2509781752
g.text: You are not to blame, Drifter. I am, as our brothers and sisters from Libertatia might say, a "hard nut to crack."

g.title: j1586803457
g.text: The horrors that echo within my mind seem to know no boundaries. I witness chains of human sinew that once oozed with fresh crimson, turned brittle and blackened.

g.title: j2868871722
g.text: I am merely a besieged individual. I hold the wall. To open the gate is to threaten the integrity of the defenses.

g.title: j619593295
g.text: I see a hundred thousand visages of my own self, similar but foreign. Hollowed caskets, corpses of twisted, broken human flesh, suspended in the veil between life and death.

g.title: j3292120761
g.text: I understand. When you're ready, we can talk.

g.title: j1360228141
g.text: How do you mean?

g.title: j3728128003
g.text: Expressions locked in a mask of empty repose. But in the flickering remains of their souls, embers that linger and do not die, I hear them screaming. Endlessly howling for retribution. For freedom.

g.title: j292431206
g.text: I am starting to come to the distinct impression that I do not have a choice in this matter.

g.title: j2666648367
g.text: For death.

g.title: j988178368
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j2593910760
g.text: These visions haunt my waking hours. My dreams. I have no nightmares, for that is all I experience - all I have become.

g.title: j887683045
g.text: But, for what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.

g.title: j1274675553
g.text: Check boolean LyonPainOff

g.title: j1407668417
g.text: All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.

g.title: j1935970551
g.text: Only when I sacrifice to the whispers that echo within my soul, is the world reflected to me in a manner similar to that which you might find familiar.

g.title: j1274675553->j1935970551
g.text: true

g.title: j241308745
g.text: Only when I rend the flesh from my body as a sacrifice to the whispers that echo within my soul, is the world reflected to me in a manner similar to that which you might find familiar.

g.title: j1274675553->j241308745
g.text: false

g.title: j3869357206
g.text: -F. Lyon Allard

g.title: j3769690399
g.text: Kindly do not pretend to know of what I "feel," Drifter. I fear you have only begun to understand.

g.title: j2522325746
g.text: Boolean LyonVisions2d is now true.

g.title: j4043560303
g.text: I - I'm sorry. No, I didn't know.

g.title: j1287152803
g.text: And there is a lot of horror and pain that I have seen that you do not understand either, Lyon.

g.title: j2255755756
g.text: I'm sorry if you feel I spoke out of turn. But I want to understand. These visions of yours...

g.title: j2902539613
g.text: Yes. Well. I have survived these long years. I will hold strong a few more, I am certain. You needn't worry over much.

g.title: j945946918
g.text: I am most certain you have, seeing some of it reflected in the imagery of this place. But do you think yourself paramount? Supreme Knower of All Horrors and All Suffering?

g.title: j102031654
g.text: Yes. Well. I have withstood them all my years. I will hold strong a few more, I am certain. You needn't worry over much.

g.title: j4270520825
g.text: Boolean LyonVisions2a is now true.

g.title: j3253682639
g.text: I'm saying I might be able to sympathize more with what you're experiencing than you think.

g.title: j39295631
g.text: I'm saying I've been through a lot of death and horror, Lyon. So I don't enjoy being spoken down to over it.

g.title: j431200296
g.text: What you're describing, Lyon... did that vision start before or after you were a protoframe?

g.title: j288742428
g.text: Can we talk about this again? Please?

g.title: j1622300909
g.text: Boolean LyonVisions2b is now true.

g.title: j2031743382
g.text: Boolean LyonVisions2c is now true.

g.title: j746167634
g.text: Were that as simple a question as you believe it to be. Regardless, it is not one I am willing to answer today. I feel a headache coming on.

g.title: j2546419310
g.text: I am starting to come to the distinct impression that I do not have a choice in this matter.

g.title: j1011438956
g.text: It may seem strange to you that I am not in search of sympathy, Drifter. Answers are what I seek. Surety. Firmament, when all is illusion and lies.

g.title: j3316146926
g.text: Than allow me to bow down at your feet. Praise you for all you have endured. Wonder how you are still sane for all you have witnessed.

g.title: j3814614150
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2351368684
g.text: I'll do what I can.

g.title: j3520552128
g.text: Then, maybe I can help you with that. Can we talk about this again? Please?

g.title: j1653090935
g.text: And marvel over how you still spare time for all the rest of us who you view so far beneath your vaulted status.

g.title: j1096335261
g.text: But, for what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.

g.title: j3971191360
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2959315451
g.text: All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.

g.title: j497522596
g.text: That is all one can ask for, is it not?
